claim: Let \(F\) be the genus-\(19\) Cartwright–Steger Albanese fiber over the fixed base point and let \(S\) be the order-three automorphism chosen so that its three fixed points on \(F\) have tangent multiplier \(\omega^2\), where \(\omega=e^{2\pi i/3}\). Then the \(S^*\)-eigenspace dimensions on \(H^{1,0}(F)\) for eigenvalues \(1,\omega,\omega^2\) are exactly \(6,6,7\). Consequently the characteristic polynomial of \(S_*\) on \(H_1(F;\mathbb Q)\) is \((t-1)^{12}(t^2+t+1)^{13}\). Equivalently, the nontrivial Prym part of the cyclic triple cover \(F\to F/\langle S\rangle\) has complex dimension \(13\) and Eisenstein Hodge multiplicities \(6\) and \(7\), up to exchanging the two embeddings of \(\mathbb Q(\omega)\).
integrity: The proof uses only the source-verified genus, fixed-point rotation data, quotient genus, and standard holomorphic Lefschetz and finite-group representation facts. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the rational homology representation and complex Hodge multiplicities, not the integral \(\mathbb Z[C_3]\)-lattice, Prym polarization type, individual vanishing class, or handle return map.
title: Hodge character of the Cartwright–Steger fiber symmetry
